title: Version 3 Live Production Deployment (Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, and VPS PM2 Suite)
objective: Execute the live production deployment of Version 3. acceptance_criteria: Compiled api/index.js pushed to origin/main with 0 build warnings.
Cloudflare Pages configuration verified in build output dist/.
